# GURU Software Studio

> GURU Software Studio builds Personal Software for Business: custom software shaped around how a company actually works — not another generic SaaS. Based in Puebla, Mexico. Serves clients remotely worldwide.

## Product definition
Personal Software for Business is custom software for a specific operation — quoting, ops, clients, inventory, bookings, dashboards, or whatever workflow the business already runs manually. Typical first version ships in 4–8 weeks. The client owns the code, accounts, and data.

## Platform API (optional)
- Platform API (Vercel `guru-platform`): POST `/api/leads` (terminal `lead email@…`), POST `/api/chat` (session message log). Home sets `data-leads-api`.

## How engagement works
1. Quick diagnostic: https://gurusoftware.studio/diagnostico/ (ES: https://gurusoftware.studio/es/diagnostico/)
2. Short scope call and personal quote
3. Fixed scope, weekly demos, go live
